column1: # Hand-written lines (README.md, extra.tsv) for targets/xkb.md §8 of the kbl spec; each outcome types differently.
# (3) x has no sequence after the acute: a´xa = the model (emitBoth), axa = cancelled and typed, aa = swallowed.
# (3) Backspace after the acute: aax = the dead key cancelled and nothing deleted, ax = a character deleted too.
# (8) the entry e has the result "": nothing between the two a.
# (10) Numpad1 is type KEYPAD [KP_End, onesuperior]: Num Lock on gives ¹; with Shift too on xkeyboard-config 2.48 and
# later (2.42 and 2.46 give the navigation keysym, no text: xkb.numLockKeyReduced says so); off gives no text.
# exist before install.sh, which appends its block to both; pre-config: only ~/.config/XCompose exists.
# The user's own line in ~/.config/XCompose: GTK 4 never reads that file, so GTK types the system's x́ (not a loss of
# the layout). The layout's own entry z → ʑ (the system has ź): GTK 4 reads it from the ~/.XCompose that install.sh
